description: Given a US HTS code, returns the duty rate that actually applies, resolving the common trap that rates sit on the 8-digit line while the 10-digit statistical lines underneath are blank and inherit. Optionally pass the country of origin to see whether a free-trade rate is available. Always reports what is excluded, because trade remedies such as Section 301 are not in this data and can dwarf the base rate.

hts_code.description: A US HTS code, with or without dots: 6212.10.90, 6212109010 or 6212.

origin_country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of origin of the GOODS, for example CN or AU. Used to check free-trade eligibility.

name: lookup_us_duty_rate
title: Look up the US duty rate that governs an HTS code
